short_description: The ultimate sports evolution platform — 12+ game modes, real-time multiplayer, Creator Cards, PRQ rating system.
full_description:
Final Evolution Lab (FEL) is a next-generation sports gaming platform built on Unreal Engine 5.7 with the Antigravity x Seele AI stack. Compete in 12+ sports modes from basketball to karate, earn Creator Cards, climb the PRQ leaderboard, and evolve your athletic profile.

FEATURES:
• 12 Production Game Modes: Basketball H2H, Dunk Contest, 3v3, Karate H2H, Karate Endless, Baseball, Football, Soccer, Golf, Tennis, Volleyball, Surfing
• Creator Card System: Collect, trade, and use real athlete cards
• PRQ Rating System: Weighted composite physical readiness quotient
• Shard Economy: Earn shards through gameplay, combos, and critical hits
• Real-time Multiplayer via Vault Hub
• AI Coaching powered by Seele AI
• Venice Beach and 10+ iconic sports venues
